DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 着付けのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss kimono dressing?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この帯留めを友人へ贈りたいです。借りる物とは別に買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借り物と別に小物購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give this obi ornament to a friend. Can I buy one separately from the rental items?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to buy an accessory separately from the rental items.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レンタルの物はそのまま返却してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please return the rental items as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これを持ち帰らず、販売用があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売品を求め借り物を保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to ask whether there is one for sale, without taking this one home.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an item for sale while keeping the borrowed item in its rental status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 販売品はこちらです。包装も希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the items for sale. Would you like gift wrapping too?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。着物のレンタル料金とは別の価格を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入とレンタル料金を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please tell me the price separately from the kimono rental fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the purchase price from the rental fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 販売品は千円、包装は百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-07.translation: The item costs 1,000 yen, and wrapping costs 100 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 千百円ですね。レンタルの明細と分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包装込合計を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's 1,100 yen. I'll check that separately from the rental breakdown.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the total including wrapping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 贈る方の名前は包装に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like the recipient's name on the wrapping?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いえ、名前なしでお願いします。借りる帯留めは使った後に返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包装名なしと借用品返却を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, please leave the name off. I'll return the rented obi ornament after using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify no name on the wrapping and return of the borrowed item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 販売用一つを名前なしで包装します。レンタル品の返却は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-030-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll wrap one item for sale without a name. We'll check the return of the rental item separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 具を別皿にできますか。友人はパンだけ先に食べたいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 具の別皿提供を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-02.translation: Could you serve the filling on a separate plate? My friend says they'd like to eat just the bread first.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the filling to be served on a separate plate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食材を避ける必要があるというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean you need to avoid certain ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、食べる順番の希望です。材料を除く依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食順の希望と食材制限を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it's a preference about the order of eating. I'm not asking you to leave any ingredients out.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an eating-order preference from an ingredient restriction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分けた提供が可能か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether we can serve them separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。料金が変わるなら先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Please tell me beforehand if the price will change.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether there is an extra charge for the change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では同じ料金で分けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this case, we can separate them for the same price.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人分の具を二人分に増やす希望でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理量は増やさないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not asking you to increase one person's portion of filling to two people's portions either.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you do not want a larger amount of food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲み物はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-09.translation: What would you like to drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それぞれ一杯です。料理一人分と飲み物二杯を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料理と飲料の数量を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-10.translation: One drink each. Let me confirm: one portion of food and two drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the quantities of food and drinks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理一人分をパンと具の二皿に分け、飲み物二杯でお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-031-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take your order as one portion, with bread and filling on two separate plates, and two drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 贈った服が小さかったそうです。今は現物を持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現物なしの代理交換を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-02.translation: The clothes I gave as a gift were apparently too small. I don't have the item with me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about exchanging a gift on someone else's behalf without the item present. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の希望サイズは確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check which size the recipient wants?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。私が一つ上と決めず本人へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の希望サイズを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I'll ask them instead of deciding myself to go one size up.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the recipient's desired size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a purchase record?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。相手が着たか、タグを外したかも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用とタグの状態が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I also need to check whether they wore it or removed the tags.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know its use or tag condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件を確認してから交換可否を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain whether an exchange is possible after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に交換用の品を取り置いた扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換品確保と決めつけない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume that a replacement has already been reserved for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume a replacement item is secured. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現物の持参方法もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also explain how to bring the item in.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の返事と商品状態を確かめて、記録と一緒に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態と記録を揃える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check their reply and the item's condition, then consult you with the purchase record.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have the condition information and record ready. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は準備の相談として承ります。希望サイズと現物状態を確認してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-032-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll treat today as a consultation about the preparations. Please check the desired size and the item's condition before bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 普段は何時ごろお休みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-01.translation: What time do you usually go to bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜十一時と書きました。でも夜勤の後は朝九時に寝るので、それだけでは違う日があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日勤後の十一時だけを記入したが夜勤後は違うと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote 11 p.m. But after a night shift I go to bed at 9 a.m., so that alone is inaccurate on some days.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your entry of only 11 p.m. after day shifts, explaining that it differs after night shifts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務によって睡眠の時間帯が変わるのですね。今週はどちらの日がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your sleeping hours change with your shifts. Which shifts do you have this week?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日勤が三日、夜勤が二日です。十一時というのは日勤の後で、毎日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今週の勤務日数と時刻の適用日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three day shifts and two night shifts. Eleven o'clock is after a day shift, not every day.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give this week's shift counts and explain which days the time applies to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの勤務と睡眠を分けて担当へ伝えましょう。実際に眠った長さも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's report the two shifts and sleep schedules separately to the person in charge. Do you also know how long you actually slept?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一日分は分かりますが、ほかは記録していません。横になった時間を全部眠った時間としません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一日分の記録と未記録及び就床睡眠の差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-06.translation: I know for one day, but haven't recorded the others. I won't count all the time spent lying down as time asleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the one day's record, the unrecorded days, and the difference between time in bed and sleep. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる記録をお持ちならお見せください。睡眠の評価は診療担当者が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have the records you know about, please show them to us. The clinical staff will assess your sleep.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今週の勤務表もあります。来週の予定を今週の実績として書かないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の勤務表と翌週予定を区別して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I also have this week's shift schedule. I'll keep next week's plans separate so I don't write them as this week's actual shifts.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the actual shift record separately from next week's plans. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録と、日による違いを引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass along those records and the differences between days.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。日勤と夜勤、就床と実際の睡眠、実績と予定を分けて診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務就床睡眠と実績予定を分けて引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. During the consultation I'll distinguish day and night shifts, time in bed and actual sleep, and actual records and plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the information to be passed along, distinguishing shifts, time in bed, sleep, actual records, and plans. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料はお手元に置いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-033-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the documents with you while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の残りについてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about how much medicine you have left?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。袋がまだ厚いので、次に来る日まで足りると思っていました。でも中は数えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋の厚さで残日数を見積もったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The bag is still thick, so I thought I had enough until my next visit. But I haven't counted what's inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you estimated the days remaining from the bag's thickness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけで残りの日数を決めず、薬剤師に相談しましょう。現在の袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's consult the pharmacist instead of deciding how many days remain from its appearance alone. Do you have the current bag with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。空の包装も入っているので、厚さと残っている錠剤の数は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空包装が混在する現物を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It also contains empty packaging, so its thickness is different from the number of tablets remaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the actual bag containing empty packaging as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現物と現在の指示を照合します。ご自身で回数を減らしたりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare the actual medicine with the current instructions. Have you reduced how often you take it on your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。足りないかもしれないからと、勝手に一日おきにするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服用回数は変えておらず自己間引きをしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I don't intend to switch to every other day on my own just because I might run out.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not changed the dosing frequency and will not skip doses on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬剤師が残りと次の受診予定を確認します。予定日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-07.translation: The pharmacist will check what's left and your next appointment. Is the date set?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週月曜です。袋に書かれた前の受取日と、次の受診日を混ぜずに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次受診日を旧受取日と分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next Monday. I'll distinguish the previous collection date written on the bag from my next appointment date.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the next appointment date separately from the old collection date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な相談先や準備を、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we'll explain whom you need to consult and what to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。空包装と残りを分けて見てもらい、足りる日数を自己計算で確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残量と現指示を照合し日数を自己確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll have the empty packaging and remaining medicine checked separately, and won't decide for myself how many days it will last.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have the remaining medicine compared with the current instructions rather than determining the number of days yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのまま薬剤師へお見せください。現在の指示も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-034-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show it to the pharmacist as it is. We'll also check the current instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご近所で見た出来事のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss something you saw in your neighborhood?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見たわけではありません。転送された投稿を読んで、自分の町の話かもしれないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 直接目撃でなく転送投稿を読んだと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-02.translation: I didn't see it myself. I read a forwarded post and thought it might be about my town.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the impression that you witnessed it, explaining that you read a forwarded post. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 投稿には場所と日時が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the post give a place and date?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 町名は似ていますが、県名が違います。日付は画像が切れていて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た町名でも県が異なり日付も不明と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-04.translation: The town name is similar, but the prefecture is different. The date is cut off in the image, so I can't read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the town name is similar but the prefecture differs and the date is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 直接の目撃ではなく、場所と時点が未確認の投稿ですね。何を相談したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it's a post you haven't witnessed directly, with its location and time unconfirmed. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の地域へ注意を広めてよいか迷っています。まず内容を確認せず近所の被害として配らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近所の実害として配布する前に相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm unsure whether I should spread a warning in my area. I'll make sure not to distribute it as local harm without first checking the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want advice before distributing it as an actual incident in your neighborhood. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ相談できます。投稿の元の情報を確認するため、受け取った状態を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can consult the person in charge. Please keep it as you received it so we can check the post's original information.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。地名を自分の町へ直した画像は作りません。転送してきた友人にも原の投稿先を尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受信画像を変えず原投稿先を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't make an image with the place name changed to my town. I'll also ask the friend who forwarded it where the original post was made.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will leave the received image unchanged and check the original posting location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個人で発信者を犯人と決めたり、場所へ確認に行ったりせずご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult us instead of deciding yourself that the sender is the culprit or going to the location to investigate.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。未確認の転送情報として見せ、近所で起きたと断定して広めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認情報として相談し地域事件と断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll show it as unverified forwarded information and won't spread it as definitely having happened nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult about it as unverified information without asserting it is a local incident. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-035-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that information to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの袋の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please describe the bag you are looking for.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い袋です。中にノートがあるそうですね。それは一覧で読んだので、自分で覚えている情報ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公開一覧の中身説明は自身の記憶ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a blue bag. Apparently there's a notebook inside. I read that on the list, so it's not something I remember myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the public list's description of the contents is not your own recollection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身が入れた物で、覚えている特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us features you remember about things you put in it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は白い封筒を入れました。封筒の表に書いた名前は、ここで静かにお伝えできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で入れた封筒の非公開特徴を静かに伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put a white envelope inside. Could I quietly tell you the name I wrote on the front of it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to quietly give a nonpublic feature of the envelope you put in yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な特徴は周囲に聞こえない方法で確認します。袋を最後に持っていた場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the necessary features in a way others cannot overhear. Where did you last have the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カフェです。その後の道のどこで失くしたか分からないので、一覧の発見場所を自分の落下場所とは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終所持場所と公開発見場所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-06.translation: At a cafe. I don't know where along the way I lost it afterward, so I can't say the place it was found on the list is where I dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish where you last had it from the publicly listed finding location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの情報を分けて照合します。発見した袋をまだ見ていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare those pieces of information separately. You haven't seen the found bag yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。青いというだけで同じ物と決めていません。照合できるか確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未見の袋を色だけで同一判断せず照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I haven't decided it's the same bag just because it's blue. Please check whether the information can be matched.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a comparison without judging an unseen bag to be yours from its color alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認する担当へ引き継ぎます。今ここで中身を自由に見る案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll refer you to the staff member who checks this. This does not mean you may freely inspect the contents here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の記憶と公開情報を分け、確認できた場合の受取方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記憶と公開情報で本人確認後の受取手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll distinguish my memories from public information and ask how to collect it if a match is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish memory from public information and ask about collection after identity verification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当の照合結果をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-036-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the staff member's comparison results.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋はどのように使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-01.translation: How do you plan to use the bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この保存袋に弁当を移して、職場の電子レンジで温めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存袋で弁当を温めたい用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to transfer my boxed lunch into this storage bag and heat it in the microwave at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to heat your lunch in a storage bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存用という表示だけでは、電子レンジで使えるとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-03.translation: A label saying it is for storage does not by itself tell us it can be used in a microwave.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 耐熱と書いてあれば使えると思っていました。レンジ使用についての表示を一緒に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 耐熱表示とレンジ使用可否の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could use it if it said heat resistant. Could we check the labeling about microwave use together?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the difference between heat resistance and suitability for microwave use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品にはレンジ使用不可とあります。弁当の元の容器にも表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-05.translation: This product says it is not microwave safe. Is there also a label on the lunch's original container?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の容器はまだ見ていません。袋を買えばどの弁当でも温められる、という考えはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元容器は未確認だと申告し袋で解決する思い込みを修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't looked at the original container yet. I'll stop assuming that buying a bag will let me heat any boxed lunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that the original container is unchecked and correct the assumption that a bag solves the problem. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職場の設備と容器の説明を確認するのがよいと思います。袋は保存用として必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-07.translation: I think you should check the workplace equipment and the container instructions. Do you need the bags for storage?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は温めることが目的なので、この袋は買いません。弁当は表示を読んで選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不要な保存袋を買わず弁当の表示を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-08.translation: My purpose today is heating, so I won't buy this bag. I'd like to read the lunch labels and choose again.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not buy an unnecessary storage bag; recheck the lunch labeling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品にも容器の注意書きがあります。見えにくければ商品を持ってきてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-09.translation: This product also has container precautions. Please bring it over if they are hard to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。注意書きを確認し、職場のレンジで使う条件が分からなければ温めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設備と容器の条件が不明なら温めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the precautions and won't heat it if I don't know the conditions for using it in the microwave at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not heat it if the equipment and container conditions are unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認ができてから選びましょう。今の袋は棚へ戻しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-037-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's choose once you've checked that. I'll put these bags back on the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの券を確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check the ticket you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 替え玉の券だけです。普通のラーメンより安いので、これを一杯として頼みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 替え玉券だけで一杯を頼もうとしたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's just a noodle-refill ticket. It was cheaper than regular ramen, so I ordered this as one bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you tried to order a bowl using only a noodle-refill ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 替え玉は追加の麺です。この券だけでスープ付きの一杯になるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-03.translation: A noodle refill is extra noodles. This ticket alone does not provide a bowl with broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の麺を別の商品に替える意味ではないのですね。まだラーメン本体は買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加麺の意味を確認し本体未購入を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it doesn't mean replacing the initial noodles with another product. I haven't bought the ramen itself yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that it means extra noodles and report that you have not purchased the main bowl. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。注文を始める前に、券の扱いと本体の選び方を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Before starting the order, let's check how to handle the ticket and choose the main bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一杯だけ食べたいです。追加の麺は今は不要なので、この券について窓口で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一杯だけの希望と券の扱い相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only want one bowl. I don't need extra noodles now, so I'd like to ask at the counter about this ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want only one bowl and advice about handling the ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 券の変更方法は担当が案内します。先に別の券を買わず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain how to change the ticket. Please wait here without buying another ticket first.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二重に買わず待ちます。希望するラーメンの種類は、メニューのこの商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加購入せず待ち希望商品を指す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait without buying twice. The kind of ramen I want is this item on the menu.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait without making another purchase and point to the item you want. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に、替え玉だけ購入済みで、本体は未購入と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that you've bought only a refill and have not bought the main bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その購入状況と一杯だけの希望を伝えてください。差額や手順を聞いてから手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入状況と希望を確認し案内後に手続きすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please explain that purchase situation and that I only want one bowl. I'll proceed after hearing the price difference and procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm what you bought and what you want, and say you will proceed after the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。まだ調理の注文には回しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-038-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the person in charge. I won't send this through as an order for cooking yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は改札内、友人は外です。友人に同じホームへ来てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 内外に分かれた合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm inside the ticket gates and my friend is outside. I'd like my friend to come to the same platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about meeting when you are on different sides of the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人も乗車予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your friend also planning to take a train?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、荷物を渡すだけです。乗車券は持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の乗車予定なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they're just handing over some luggage. They don't have a train ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is not planning to travel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入場の方法は係員へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check the entry procedure with station staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 無料で入れるとは伝えず、私が出る方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人入場と本人退出を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't tell them they can enter free, and I'd also like to ask about the option of me going out.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare your friend's entry with your own exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの券の途中退出について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the rules for exiting during a journey with your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。確認前に出口へ券を通しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券の扱い確認前に退出しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I won't put it through the exit gate before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not exit before checking how the ticket should be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人には今どこで待つよう伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-09.translation: Where will you tell your friend to wait for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中央改札の外です。別の入口へ動かないよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外の待機場所を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-10.translation: Outside the central ticket gate. I'll tell them not to move to another entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your friend where to wait outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その場所で合流する方法を係員が案内します。今は券を保持して窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-039-001-SHARED-11.translation: Station staff will explain how you can meet there. For now, keep your ticket and go to the counter.
